principle: Each defect becomes a bounded parameter experiment with before/after geometry and independent human visual review. This is not neural-network training or automatic aesthetic judgement.
immutable_guards: preserve armored Bellwarden gameplay and Easter egg
preserve M25 reviewed source and M24 source history
four distinct fingers plus opposed thumb per hand
do not claim photorealism from metric scores

stages.name: Reference anatomy and silhouette
goals: compare front/side/back/three-quarter body proportions to supplied Bellwarden Base Body Test reference
correct torso vs leg and natural limb silhouette

stages.name: Facial planes and real anatomy
goals: integrated orbital sockets, eyelid rims, nasal bridge and alae
jaw/cheek anatomy without floating beads
neutral lip seam, face loops and bilateral geometry
gates: reviewer verifies no floating/painted-on face details

stages.name: Hands, feet and functional anatomy
goals: five anatomical digits per hand, open gaps, opposable thumb
arched foot and heel/toe transitions
cross-angle wrist and ankle attachment
gates: six hand views and both feet

stages.name: Sculpt continuity and corrective surfaces
goals: remove pillowy isolated muscle bumps
smooth shoulder/chest/abdomen/leg insertions
preserve anatomical landmarks through small local offsets
gates: no degraded silhouettes or high detail regression

stages.name: Retopology and UV master
goals: create coherent facial and muscle deformation loops
reduce open boundaries, degenerates, nonmanifold regions
produce meaningful UV island charts

stages.name: PBR skin and fine surfaces
goals: physically credible base color, pores, fine micro-normals, AO and roughness
reduce plastic response and eliminate shader glitter
test material under standard/moon/ember light

stages.name: Rigging and expressive deformation
goals: skin weights preserve eyelid, mouth, shoulder, elbows, hips, knees and ankles
validate attachments over full motion
introduce facial expression controls and realistic motion

stages.name: Mobile/performance and gameplay Testing Grounds
goals: identical-source Android 15 emulator farm
compare candidate against preserved knight gameplay stability
accept human only after manual reference review
gates: all emulator reports same commit and APK
actual mobile FPS and budget evidence

stages.name: Generalize sculpt lessons to every asset
goals: reuse region-aware mesh sculpting for creatures, armor, architecture, props and environments
add artist-approved lesson recipes to reusable engine
measure transfer rather than assume it
gates: unit tests for new asset families
no loss of prior working features

feedback_schema.warning: Structured labels are explicitly curated from manually observed renders. No automatic screenshot recognition in this version.

dials.direction: positive value moves orbital surface inward
positive subtly rounds dorsal ankle/heel transition
